name: copytrade
title: Copy trading
summary: People copy another trader's positions with an allocation of their own, with risk limits, stops and an optional profit share for the trader.

env.name: COPYTRADE_PAUSED
env.doc: Kill switch: true stops new copies, copied orders, reconcile and resumes. Stops, stop losses, withdrawals and closes still work; copies are not stopped.

env.name: COPYTRADE_MIN_ALLOCATION
env.doc: Smallest allocation a copy starts with, in the exchange's quote currency (leaders may ask for more).

env.name: COPYTRADE_MAX_PROFIT_SHARE_PCT
env.doc: Highest profit share a leader may take, in percent of gains above the high-water mark (0–50).

env.name: COPYTRADE_MAX_COPIERS_PER_LEADER
env.doc: Most open copies one leader may have (1–10000); leaders may set fewer.

env.name: COPYTRADE_MAX_COPIES_PER_FOLLOWER
env.doc: Most open copies one person may have (1–100).

env.name: COPYTRADE_SETTLE_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often profit shares are settled (1h–2160h); also on every withdrawal and stop.

env.name: COPYTRADE_LEADER_MIN_AGE_DAYS
env.doc: Default leader rule: the account is at least this many days old (0–3650).

env.name: COPYTRADE_LEADER_MIN_FILLS
env.doc: Default leader rule: at least this many fills on the person's main trading account.

env.name: COPYTRADE_EVENT_RETENTION
env.doc: How long copy activity (orders, skips, transfers) is kept (24h or more).

env.name: COPYTRADE_WORKERS
env.doc: Parallel workers that place copied orders (1–64).

stitch: Decide whether copy trading may run at all: with real-money collateral it is portfolio management or investment advice in most countries (FEATURE.md → Compliance). With test funds, say so on screen.
Rewrite the risk disclosure for your product (backend/internal/copytrade/disclosure.go) and change DisclosureVersion when its substance changes.

Decide who may lead: the default needs an active account COPYTRADE_LEADER_MIN_AGE_DAYS old with COPYTRADE_LEADER_MIN_FILLS fills; replace it with copytrade.SetEligibility (FEATURE.md → Stitching shows a reputation rule).
Set the limits: COPYTRADE_MIN_ALLOCATION, COPYTRADE_MAX_PROFIT_SHARE_PCT, COPYTRADE_MAX_COPIERS_PER_LEADER, COPYTRADE_MAX_COPIES_PER_FOLLOWER, COPYTRADE_SETTLE_INTERVAL.
Link to traders: the directory is /leaders; link a person's name elsewhere in the app (profiles, the leaderboard) to /leaders?leader=<user id>, which opens their start sheet.
With moderation installed, stop copies between people who block each other: call (*copytrade.Service).StopBetween from a stitch (FEATURE.md → Extending).
Know the kill switch: COPYTRADE_PAUSED=true halts copying without stopping copies (restart to apply).
